title: MV "Ericanskinsmonsters" - story rich, turn-based combat, jrpg, dark comedy, monsters, undead, apocalyptic

posts.author: SmirkSmileGrin_Games
posts.body:
Hello!
Hey this is Eric the dev. A lot of people are going to wonder why Ericanskinsmonsters? Well I always wanted to get into game dev and for my first game I wanted to make a backstory to the name that my wife chose as her first ever MMO character name. So...this is the epic tale I came up with to tell the story behind the name epic name "Ericanskinsmonsters". You can find the game available for purchase on Steam/PC(link)
Content
-
This game was truly a passion project in my free time and I hope players enjoy the atmosphere and details I tried to build upon in order to create a mature audience/enjoyable dark comedy apocalyptic rpg that was a canvas for me to express myself. The game consist of 5 playable classes that evolve and a golem summon which swaps out with Erica. It has tons of spells, buffs/debuffs, armor, weapons, shops, monstrous bosses, triggers, storyline content, hidden treasure, gold, level progression, dungeons/maps and features a large amount of artwork/music/addons from other Steam/RPG Maker MV community developers such as myself, my daughter, Tyler Warren, Andy Chen, Hibiki Katakura, and more. (Big shout out to RPG MAKER MV and other credited artist) I included many addons from Yanfly to enhance Ericanskinsmonsters gameplay to include the battle system/quest journals/game text.
Follow up/game content rating
-
If you would like to follow my upcoming projects or read more about the game then you can find guides and such on my webpage I am working on
https://smirksmilegringames.com/
. This game took close to a decade to learn the software, gather artwork I liked/creating the world/music/audios/story/massive triggers and pretty in-depth combat, in which players will need to user counter elements, stuns, heals, items, campsites, and combat mechanic knowledge to overcome difficult enemies!  The game probably hits in the teen rating for adult language, alcohol use, violence, and some scantily clad art works I chose to use, but it's fairly clean.(no nudity/no sexual content) As far as AI gen content, the only AI gen content used is cover art on Steam which I massively edited afterward, and some say content you random generated using RPG Maker MV has to be disclosed as well(which I randomized some sprites and maps and then edited afterward). "disclaimer" This game is an apocalyptic type twist in another world and there is mentions of
religion
as you can see members of the party take on characteristics/abilities of their worlds version of the four horsemen.  It all takes places in some other world/reality(it's a game), but I know it will upset someone...but it's an emotional game I think; so good
I was angry at myself for doing certain things, making certain choices...it upset me as the player, but I was happy and relieved later on. I think it just adds to my morbid humor haha. No honestly I beat the game countless times and each time I added more content to increase the mood/gameplay/story and every time I think I enjoyed it immensely more.
Let me know what you think
!
I hope you truly enjoy the game I created if you choose to try it out/purchase it, then let me know what you think; my email is below.
Have fun & Game On!
